run_GTestOutputTest: run the GTestOutputTest testOutput method to compare gtest output against the golden file
run_gengolden: run gtest_output_test.py with the --gengolden flag to regenerate the golden output file
normalize_output: normalize gtest program output by converting line endings and removing locations and stack traces
remove_locations: remove all file location info from gtest output replacing paths with filename colon hash colon format
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified test cases from gtest output by matching a regex pattern
